title: Positive proportion conjecture for partitions into MSTD subsets
source: Hung Viet Chu, Noah Luntzlara, Steven J. Miller and Lily Shao, “Infinite Families of Partitions into MSTD Subsets”, arXiv:1808.05460 (2019). (https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.05460)

lanes.final_paper_definition_and_prior_art_che: final-paper-check-331690-340121-sol62-20261119-r1/CHECK-340121.md (GPT-6.2 Sol, PASS WITH EDITORIAL EDITS; revised paper used)

significance.root_decision: For every fixed k >= 2 there are a constant c > 0 and a threshold R such that for all r >= R at least a proportion c of the partitions of {1, ..., r} into k nonempty classes have every class an MSTD set (more sums than differences). This proves the positive-proportion conjecture of Chu, Luntzlara, Miller and Shao; the case k = 2 is due to Asada, Manski, Miller and Suh. The new ingredient is a k-colouring of Z/2hZ, h odd, in which antipodal residues get different colours and every colour class has full modular sumset, laid periodically on both ends of the interval.
significance.caveat: Significance modest (review 0.35). Journal versions and the classical MSTD papers were not read in full; no proof for k >= 3 was found in a bounded search, and the ProbXiv record is open.
